blockers.summary: Gate M parent approval hashing, live validation and M0 model binding use separate reads; an adversarial replacement after validation was accepted.
Loaded vllm or vllm.* module entries without __file__ and spec.origin are silently skipped; an originless injected module was omitted without failure.

observations: Gate M/M0 model-ledger and prompt-fixture equality exists, but the driver multi-read TOCTOU prevents closure.
PYTHONPATH removal, isolated -I launch and file-backed loaded-module validation are otherwise effective.
Every model-ledger validation binds the exact frozen model ID and revision.
The Mixtral BF16/no-quantization/no-offload 28672+4096 by three-launch contract is unchanged.
claim_boundary: CPU-only same-hash governance and adversarial mock evidence; no actual vLLM, model, GPU or measured capacity evidence.
